rv.q: The result is both joyful and moving.
This electrifying rock 'n' roll musical has audiences dancing in the aisles.
Staged as an impromptu jamming session, the performance is filled with recognisable songs that you are encouraged to bounce along to.
The show itself is also less than perfect: by the seventh song, the dramatic structure begins to show its limitations.
This combination of a lively cast, impressive musicianship, and atmospheric design makes this show feel like a living piece of rock ’n’ roll history.
Million Dollar Quartet is a really fun night out, with plenty of opportunity to sing and dance alongside some of the most famous singers in musical history.
What it does offer is an enjoyable exploration of what might have happened on a particular night at the birth of a musical revolution.
Million Dollar Quartet is a pitch‑perfect explosion of nostalgia, talent and sheer rock ’n’ roll magic.

Million Dollar Quartet never dives deep into its plot and the audience never receives more than a few snippets of biographical information about the four stars, it nevertheless succeeds in delivering precisely what its audience wants.

cn.t: Critics praise this electrifying rock 'n' roll musical for its infectious energy and superb musicianship, with audiences dancing in the aisles. The show successfully celebrates four music legends while delivering a joyful, crowd-pleasing night of classic hits.
